prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and component identity alignment. Make a single clean standalone master illustration of the UNDERSEA TRAIN, one of the four Social Brave King machines. Image 1 provides the original train identity only; image 2 is the authoritative combined robot, whose white/orange train shells are on the OUTSIDE of its forearms; image 3 explains the existing split shell idea only, not a template to paste a robot hand into a vehicle. Landscape 3:2 canvas, ivory studio background, ONE whole train in a readable front-side three-quarter view, fully in frame. Same precise KINETIC_CEL ink contours and large clean cel-shaded armor surfaces as image 2; avoid photoreal metal, grime, underwater scenery, titles and text.

Design one compact futuristic amphibious rail vehicle formed by EXACTLY TWO near-identical cab-ended sections joined back-to-back by a clearly visible dark articulated CENTRAL coupling. A blue-glazed streamlined cab is at EACH OUTER END; the flat coupling ends meet at the middle. The two halves are the future left and right arm-shell units, not two extra trains. Each section has an ivory-white rounded angular shell, a strong narrow orange side stripe, a blue-black side window band with a few clear window divisions, a wide blue curved cab windshield, a compact graphite lower chassis, and a pair of short fold-flat side stabilizer vanes integrated into the lower chassis. Keep each half compact and sturdy enough to be recognizable as the forearm shell seen in image 2. Both cab shapes and the orange/ivory/glass proportions must visibly match that combined forearm armor. No extra carriages or duplicated cab at the central coupling.

Include a restrained longitudinal seam on the upper centerline and small matching side hinge/slide details: after uncoupling, each section can open into left and right side-shell leaves around an existing reinforced robot forearm. The cab end goes toward the ELBOW/REAR in combined form; the exposed former coupling end faces the fist/front. Draw only the CLOSED vehicle in this master, no robot fist, no cannon barrel, no exposed person. Train parts are outer shells; they do not create the robot's giant fists. Keep the same shell design on both halves, recognizable panel breaks and restrained markings, no logos or lettering. Only two sections, two outer cabs, one central coupling; no unrelated flight wings or tall aircraft fins.
